en_title: As Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns, the Future of GeForce Hangs in the Balance
cn_title: 随着英伟达CEO黄仁勋辞职，GeForce的未来悬而未决
opus_summary: 文章称，黄仁勋在涉及一名疑似中国间谍的丑闻后辞去英伟达CEO一职，首席财务官Collette Kress暂任CEO。作者认为英伟达可能进一步聚焦人工智能和数据中心业务，GeForce受到的关注或将减少，但预计公司短期内不会退出游戏业务。

paragraphs.en: After 33 years, Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia , following a scandal involving a suspected Chinese spy. This has all kinds of implications for the economy as a whole but Huang's exit will certainly have a ripple effect on the world of PC gaming, too. With Nvidia CFO Collette Kress stepping in as interim CEO as the company searches for a permanent replacement, it's looking increasingly unlikely that GeForce is going to get much attention going forward.
paragraphs.cn: 在一家涉及一名疑似中国间谍的丑闻发生后，黄仁勋在英伟达任职33年后辞职。此事对整体经济有着各种各样的影响，但黄仁勋的离职肯定也会给PC游戏界带来连锁反应。随着英伟达CFO Collette Kress在公司寻找永久继任者期间接任临时CEO，GeForce今后获得太多关注的可能性看起来越来越小。

paragraphs.en: Kress joined Nvidia in 2013, as the GeForce GTX 780 was coming out , and has helped guide the company through its transformation into a data center and AI powerhouse. Before Nvidia, she was at Cisco as the CFO of Business Technology and Operations Finance, and before that, she was CFO of the Servers and Tools Group at Microsoft. Her history, combined with Nvidia's current trajectory, means that AI is still going to be Nvidia's main business. After all, Nvidia has made hundreds of billions of dollars pursuing AI, so having a CFO in charge, even in the interim, probably means Team Green is going to push even harder for the AI market.
paragraphs.cn: Kress于2013年加入英伟达，当时GeForce GTX 780正要推出，她帮助引领公司转型为数据中心和AI领域的巨头。加入英伟达之前，她在思科担任业务技术与运营财务CFO；再之前，她是微软服务器与工具部门的CFO。她的履历，加上英伟达目前的发展方向，意味着AI仍将是英伟达的主营业务。毕竟，英伟达在AI领域赚取了数千亿美元，因此让一位CFO掌舵，即便只是临时接任，也很可能意味着绿队将更加积极地进军AI市场。

paragraphs.en: On the surface, then, nothing would really be changing for the company. I've been covering Nvidia for more than a decade now, and I've watched in real time as GeForce has become a smaller and smaller part of its CES showcases. Just this year, Nvidia straight up dropped gaming from its earnings reports , combining the category with "edge computing," along with robotics and mobile computing.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，表面上看，这家公司实际上不会有什么变化。我报道英伟达已有十多年，亲眼见证了GeForce在其CES展示中所占的比重越来越小。就在今年，英伟达直接从财报中取消了游戏类别，将其与「边缘计算」、机器人和移动计算合并。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia almost certainly would have continued deprioritizing GeForce, regardless of Huang's exit. The difference, though, is that Huang has been with Nvidia from the beginning, when it was primarily a gaming company. Despite pushing AI as the centerpiece of Nvidia's mission since at least 2016, he at least recognized that gaming was great for Nvidia's public image and would throw gamers a bone every now and then.
paragraphs.cn: 无论黄仁勋是否离职，英伟达几乎肯定都会继续降低GeForce的优先级。不过，区别在于，黄仁勋从英伟达创立之初就一直在公司，当时它主要是一家游戏公司。尽管至少从2016年起，他就一直将AI作为英伟达使命的核心来推动，但他至少认识到游戏对英伟达的公众形象非常有利，也会时不时给玩家一点好处。

paragraphs.en: To be clear, I don't think Nvidia is going to be exiting the gaming business any time soon. Nvidia has a stranglehold on the entire PC gaming market, and it'd be bad business to walk away from a space where they have a near monopoly. There will still probably be new GeForce cards coming out — it's likely the RTX 60 series will come out in 2028 — but I think there's a real risk of Nvidia growing complacent with its market share and releasing worse products as the company invests most of its R&D into its data center business.
paragraphs.cn: 明确地说，我不认为英伟达会在短期内退出游戏业务。英伟达牢牢控制着整个PC游戏市场，放弃一个它几乎处于垄断地位的领域并不是明智的商业决策。新的GeForce显卡可能仍会推出——RTX 60系列很可能会在2028年推出——但我认为，随着英伟达将大部分研发投入到数据中心业务，它确实有可能对自己的市场份额变得自满，推出更差的产品。

paragraphs.en: There had already been signs of things getting worse for PC gamers. The RTX 50 series had a couple of duds and had brutal price hikes across the board. But no matter how you look at it, Nvidia's current-generation graphics cards are still the best in the business and are supported by a wide swath of software that is unmatched by AMD and Intel.
paragraphs.cn: 此前已有迹象表明，PC玩家面临的情况正在恶化。RTX 50系列中有几款产品表现不佳，而且全系列价格大幅上涨。但无论怎么看，英伟达的当代显卡仍然是业内最好的，并有大量软件提供支持，这一点是AMD和英特尔无法匹敌的。

paragraphs.en: I would love to be proven wrong, but I could see GeForce falling into a slump parallel to Intel's after Skylake in 2015, when Team Blue followed its consumer CPUs with more and more rebadges of the same architecture (Kaby Lake, Coffee Lake, etc.) because it had consumer market dominance and simply made more money elsewhere. During that time, Intel also had a transitional CEO, Brian Krzanich, who helped Intel expand into other industries.
paragraphs.cn: 我很希望事实证明我是错的，但我能想象GeForce陷入类似英特尔在2015年Skylake之后经历的低迷：当时蓝队在后续消费级CPU中越来越多地给同一架构换名推出（Kaby Lake、Coffee Lake等），因为它在消费市场占据主导地位，而在其他领域赚钱更多。在那段时间，英特尔也有一位过渡期CEO Brian Krzanich，他帮助英特尔向其他行业扩张。

paragraphs.en: AMD could get its act together and come out with something awesome to compete, just like it did with Ryzen in 2017. But AMD CEO Lisa Su has said in a recent interview with Yahoo Finance that "we are a data-center first company," so the odds of that happening are looking grim.
paragraphs.cn: AMD可能会整顿旗鼓，拿出出色的产品参与竞争，就像它在2017年推出Ryzen时那样。但AMD CEO苏姿丰最近在接受Yahoo Finance采访时表示，「我们是一家以数据中心为先的公司」，因此这种情况发生的希望看起来很渺茫。

paragraphs.en: The real casualties from the fallout are probably going to be the weirder gaming releases that Nvidia sprinkles throughout the year. In January, that was G-Sync Pulsar , a new form of G-Sync, which flickers the backlight of your gaming monitor to trick your eyes into thinking the display is running at a higher refresh rate. That technology was essentially a passion project that had been cooking in the background for years before finally landing in a few gaming monitors at CES 2026. Tto this day I wish it was found in more gaming monitors .
paragraphs.cn: 这场风波真正的牺牲品，可能会是英伟达在一年中不时推出的那些更奇特的游戏产品。今年1月推出的就是G-Sync Pulsar，这是一种新形式的G-Sync，它通过让游戏显示器的背光闪烁，欺骗你的眼睛，使其以为显示器正以更高的刷新率运行。这项技术本质上是一个出于热情开发的项目，在幕后酝酿多年后，终于在CES 2026上应用于几款游戏显示器。直到今天，我仍然希望有更多游戏显示器采用它。

paragraphs.en: I suspect GeForce is going to look a lot different than it does now in a few years. If Nvidia ends up with a CEO who has a career history anything like Kress's, I'd expect less of a focus on GPUs you can slot into your gaming PC, and more of a focus on funneling more GPUs into data centers. I just hope that I'm wrong.
paragraphs.cn: 我怀疑，几年后GeForce的面貌将与现在大不相同。如果英伟达最终任命的CEO有着与Kress类似的职业经历，我预计公司会减少对能装入游戏PC的GPU的关注，更加注重向数据中心输送更多GPU。我只希望我是错的。
